description: ceammc is a Pure Data library and distribution providing an extensive suite of C++ external objects for audio signal processing, synthesis, GUI elements, and data/list manipulation. Developed at the Moscow Conservatory Centre for Electroacoustic Music, its objects are structured by function to facilitate music composition, live performance, and education.

research.notes: The library is maintained primarily by Serge Poltavski (@uliss) and Alex Nadzharov. It is available both as a standalone Pure Data distribution (Pd-ceammc) and as an external library installable via Pd's built-in Deken package manager. The repository at https://github.com/uliss/pure-data redirects to https://github.com/uliss/pd-ceammc.
